subject: Social Media
title: Cialdini's Principles Online
description: A micro-lesson that makes Cialdini's Principles Online usable.

hook.text: Robert Cialdini identified six persuasion principles in 1984. Social media weaponized all of them.

buildup.text: Reciprocity, scarcity, authority, consistency, liking, and social proof—all amplified online.

discovery.text: Influencer marketing exploits 'liking' and 'social proof' simultaneously. You trust people you admire.

twist.text: Scarcity is manufactured online. 'Only 3 left!' 'Offer ends tonight!' Digital goods never run out.

climax.text: Cialdini added a seventh principle in 2016: unity—the shared identity between influencer and follower.

punchline.text: Persuasion didn't change. The scale did.

quiz.question: What seventh principle did Cialdini add in 2016?
